title: Coding agents for production iOS: a senior engineer's setup for 2x the output
summary: Vova Ignatov reports that eight months of daily agent use on Anytype's production iOS app more than doubled his tracked output, attributing the change to reviewed, codebase-specific skills, detailed task context, isolated worktrees, and simulator evidence rather than exotic tooling. Experienced iOS teams can start with one recurring task, document each agent mistake in a focused skill, and require code review plus simulator proof before expanding autonomy.
takeaway: Pick one recurring iOS task and run a correction loop: brief it with existing patterns, review every line, verify in the simulator, and turn each new failure mode into a reviewed skill.
